summary.text: Barbara Drummond is a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 103, elected November 4, 2014.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative profile, she graduated from Murphy High School and the University of South Alabama with a bachelor's degree in communications.

The profile says she was a Mobile Register reporter for 21 years, a City of Mobile administrative services and community affairs executive director, and Mobile County public affairs director, and owns B-Inspired Marketing and Consulting Inc.
